## What + why (1 line)

## Type (tick one)
- [ ] `feat:` new trick
- [ ] `fix:` bug repair
- [ ] `chore:`/docs/test only

> Word shape matters: release bot (auto version) reads the `feat:`/`fix:` prefix.

## Proof
- [ ] `pytest tests/ -q` green
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` clean (or noted why not)
- [ ] No secrets pasted (keys, passwords, tokens)
- [ ] Screenshots for UI change (if any)
